interpretation_limits: Calendar-year animals can recur across years and are not independent animals when year counts are summed.
The 100-row/7-day count describes temporal coverage only; it is not a replacement admission threshold for any frozen analysis.
Simultaneous-day source participation does not verify shared locations, a common resource pool, social association, or ecological partitioning.
Source visible and valid coordinate ranges do not establish location error, behavioral comparability, or biological independence.
Reference sex/site/deployment coverage and tag reuse must inform any later cohort design before movement effects are inspected.

methods.cadence: Sorted adjacent timestamps within animal and year; positive gaps only, duplicate timestamps separately counted; row-weighted and animal-median summaries both reported.
methods.calendar_basis: Native source timestamps. README defines timestamp units as UTC or GPS time; naive timestamps are not silently asserted to be verified UTC. No GPS/UTC leap-second correction.
methods.concurrency: Same recorded calendar day anywhere in the source, not simultaneous fixes or shared habitat/site.
methods.event_filter: Source GPS sensor, explicit visible TRUE/1, nonempty animal ID, source expected taxon, finite in-range coordinates and parseable timestamp; no movement or effect filter.
methods.gps_selection: Complete source GPS sets only, under a total 150 MB budget; deer before stork. File size is the only source acquisition criterion.
methods.privacy: No animal IDs, tag IDs, positions, exact dates, or per-animal rows emitted.

scope: Two pre-existing candidates; original source acquisition and aggregate temporal availability only

rules.clock_basis: UTC-like source clock; timezone-aware times normalized to UTC, naive source timestamps retained. Source README allows UTC or GPS time; GPS/UTC offset unresolved.
rules.cotagged_dates: For each supported animal, distinct dates with another context-qualified animal in at least one same 5 km/6 h context. Other animal need not pass the final 3-date condition. This is not exact fix simultaneity.
rules.grid: Equirectangular, 111320 m/degree, longitude scaled by cosine of the all-valid-source-row mean latitude, origin (0 degrees, 0 degrees). Mean latitude is not emitted.
rules.selection: All 36 calendar months retained, including zero-supported months; no favorable-month or effect selection.
